verdict.rationale: Stripe Financial Connections is a bank-account data API, not an agent or AI host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this product type. The evidence describes only Stripe's own MCP server, which serves tools to other agents. It does not show the product plugging in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
